scenario.name: Intermittent WAN circuit outage that self-recovers
scenario.description: The New York WAN circuit drops for about eleven minutes and recovers on its own; routing has reconverged by the time the incident is investigated.

incident.title: New York office lost all services for several minutes, now working again
incident.description: New York users lost ERP, e-mail and internet at the same time for roughly ten minutes. Service came back without intervention and users ask whether it will happen again.
symptoms: All applications unavailable for about ten minutes
Monitoring alarms for New York devices cleared on their own

ground_truth.root_cause: Carrier A circuit WAN-NYC-0001 lost signal for about eleven minutes; LNK-WAN-NYC went down, the BGP session between NYC-RTR-01 and CORE-RTR-01 dropped and all New York routes were withdrawn until the circuit recovered and BGP re-established.
